test_wait_for_ready_default: test the TestWaitForReady class to verify RPC fails immediately when wait_for_ready is None
test_wait_for_ready_disabled: test the TestWaitForReady class to verify RPC fails immediately when wait_for_ready is False
test_wait_for_ready_enabled: test the TestWaitForReady class to verify RPC recovers when wait_for_ready is True and server starts
run_perform_unary_unary: run the async _perform_unary_unary function to execute a unary-unary gRPC call with wait_for_ready
run_perform_stream_stream: run the async _perform_stream_stream function to execute a full-duplex streaming gRPC call with wait_for_ready
